body:
Here's a recording that shows the issue:

[![asciicast](https://asciinema.org/a/29QKHbWBimeWW5NLiEOphvrNO.svg)](https://asciinema.org/a/29QKHbWBimeWW5NLiEOphvrNO)
I'm unable to reproduce this using Visual Studio code, so this looks like a NeoVim bug and not a rust-analyzer bug.
This issue doesn't happen on my laptop, which is running on https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/a2e5c2f7c. I'll see which commit since then may have caused this.
<https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/f2722884a88170d62bd2509b94cda759d5312646> looks like the only relevant one.

Per `git bisect`:

```
f2722884a88170d62bd2509b94cda759d5312646 is the first bad commit
commit f2722884a88170d62bd2509b94cda759d5312646
Author: Mathias Fußenegger <mfussenegger@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Thu Nov 25 02:49:34 2021 +0100

    perf(lsp)!: use faster line retrieval for utf-16 to byte idx conversion (#16360)

 runtime/doc/lsp.txt          |  20 -----
 runtime/lua/vim/lsp/util.lua | 200 +++++++++++++++++++++----------------------
 2 files changed, 98 insertions(+), 122 deletions(-)
```

So it seems f2722884a88170d62bd2509b94cda759d5312646 may be to blame here.
In the mean time I'll simply use c132144d2458ff9458c9f7a24e280d37cdd8c216 but pull in the fixes from https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/16431.
